bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.BindingWrite.s.description:
BindingWrite is one observed write to an alias: a binding of the name to
 a subject from valid_from on, or its release.

^(firstKey)$.description:
The key of the first confirmation, when the write joins several: the
 same name bound to the same subject by observations with greater keys.
 Absent for a write that joins none.

^(subjectId)$.description:
The subject as written, or empty for a release without a redirect. The
 store does not look inside a state value, so it can't replace a ref here:
 an entry for a subject its ChangeSet creates names the subject in its
 key (docs/spec/contracts.md, "State keys") and leaves this empty.

^(validFrom)$.description:
Where the write starts in valid time, extending to infinity. Absent
 means all valid time (id aliases) or, with tentative, no start.

first_key.description:
The key of the first confirmation, when the write joins several: the
 same name bound to the same subject by observations with greater keys.
 Absent for a write that joins none.

key.description:
The write's ordering key; for a joined write, that of the last
 confirmation.

released.description:
The name is released from valid_from on; subject_id, if set, is where
 it redirects.

subject_id.description:
The subject as written, or empty for a release without a redirect. The
 store does not look inside a state value, so it can't replace a ref here:
 an entry for a subject its ChangeSet creates names the subject in its
 key (docs/spec/contracts.md, "State keys") and leaves this empty.

tentative.description: Written by a reference when minting a placeholder.

valid_from.description:
Where the write starts in valid time, extending to infinity. Absent
 means all valid time (id aliases) or, with tentative, no start.

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.BindingWrite.s.title: Binding Write

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.BindingWrites..description:
BindingWrites is every write to one alias, in no particular order. The
 binding timeline in the graph is computed from it. It gains a write when a
 sync binds the alias to a subject differently from before.
bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.BindingWrites..title: Binding Writes

bearing.resolver.v1alpha1.OrderingKey.sc.description:
OrderingKey is the key every write is compared by, left to right:
 (observed_at, observation_id, event_id, content_hash)
 (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Ordering and idempotency"). The strings compare
 by their UTF-8 bytes; pkg/model compares keys.

^(contentHash)$.description:
Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the JCS form of the observation's data; for a
 manual event, of the payload.

^(eventId)$.description: The event that carried it, which includes the source.

^(observationId)$.description: The observation that made the write; for a manual event, the event ID.
